established.claim: A domain-registration availability check compares the exact string that was sent.
The registration went through even though the submitted string was a misspelling of the intended word.
The misspelled string became permanent in the public record.

unresolved.claim: The actual domain name and the intended word are never named in the accepted narration.
unresolved.decision: visuals use structural descriptions only; no example strings may be shown

unresolved.claim: No registrar, registry or company is named in the accepted narration.
unresolved.decision: interface recreations must stay generic and marked illustrative

unresolved.claim: No dates, prices or other numeric specifics appear in the accepted narration.
unresolved.decision: no numeric claims may appear in any payload without new evidence
